claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year FHA loan rates generally hover in the high-5% to mid-6% range.
As of late March 2026, many lenders offer 30-year FHA loan rates around 5.8%–5.9% for qualified borrowers.
FHA loans require a minimum 3.5% down payment for credit scores of 580 or higher.
FHA loans require a 10% down payment for credit scores between 500 and 579.
30-Year Fixed FHA loan rates are typically between 5.799% and 6.78%.
FHA loans require an upfront mortgage insurance premium of 1.75%.
FHA loans require monthly mortgage insurance for the life of the loan in most cases.
FHA loans require the home to be a primary residence.
